newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa vulnerable if Sept breaks 1,000 stg.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa vulnerable if Sept breaks 1,000 stg.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30

Cocoa futures look rather vulnerable to further falls if the market breaks the key support at 1,000 stg basis July and ends the current dull and familiar trading ranges, technical analysts said on Thursday.
Adrian Haylor, an analyst at Sucden, said September cocoa on Wednesday broke the 40-day moving average of 1,034 stg to end the day at 1,016.
The next key support was 1,000 stg, followed by the chart gap at 989 and 996.
"If 1,000 breaks, the market looks rather vulnerable," he said. "At below 1,000, the market has a bit further to go."
On the upside, the main goal was seen at 1,035 and then 1,050.
Haylor said the cocoa charts had been trendless with prices hovering between 1,000 and 1,070 for three months now.
London's July contract hit a month low of 990 stg on Wednesday on fund liquidation.
Broker GNI said the key area was now the 980 level. "If this holds, then the market will simply be seen as maintaining the current range, if not a massive top will be in place," it said.
"Fears of forced liquidation of big trade house positions would then start to mount, pushing prices lower in a wish fulfilment action, but at present 980 stg is still holding," it added.
